purpose: Exact disposable proof driver sources retained for reproduction. Reconstruct each source at its recorded output/concurrent-local path and run from repository root with the recorded Node version. Drivers create/remove their own temporary SQLite files; actual-project reads require the existing backed-up project. Never recreate a missing live database from export.

import{SQLiteRepository}from'../../src/persistence/sqlite.ts';import{Tracer}from'../../src/index.ts';
const r=new SQLiteRepository(process.argv[2]),t=new Tracer(r);process.on('message',async m=>{try{const parts=m.method.split('.');let owner=t;for(const p of parts.slice(0,-1))owner=owner[p];const start=performance.now(),result=await owner[parts.at(-1)](...m.args);process.send({id:m.id,result,durationMs:performance.now()-start,memory:process.memoryUsage()});}catch(e){process.send({id:m.id,error:{code:e.code,message:e.message},memory:process.memoryUsage()});}});process.on('disconnect',()=>r.close());process.send({ready:true,memory:process.memoryUsage()});

import{writeFileSync}from'node:fs';import assert from'node:assert/strict';import prettier from'prettier';import{Tracer}from'../../src/index.ts';import{SQLiteRepository}from'../../src/persistence/sqlite.ts';
const r=new SQLiteRepository('projects/tracer/tracer.sqlite');try{const t=new Tracer(r),pair={beforeId:'96dd613d-1bb6-4d45-a661-4056b649eea6',afterId:'841b02ea-59d9-4839-a655-45fceabe5217'},before=(await t.timeline()).head;let boundary;try{await t.configurations.compareDependencies({...pair,limit:25});throw Error('Expected existing cap rejection');}catch(error){assert.equal(error.code,'validation');boundary={limit:25,code:error.code,message:error.message};}let after,totalBytes=0,digest;const pages=[],ids=[],start=performance.now(),initialMemory=process.memoryUsage();do{const result=await t.configurations.compareDependencies({...pair,limit:1,...(after?{after}:{})});if(digest!==undefined)assert.equal(result.discovery.evidenceRevision,digest);else digest=result.discovery.evidenceRevision;const bytes=Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(result));totalBytes+=bytes;ids.push(...result.evaluations.items.map(x=>x.receipt.id));pages.push({bytes,pageDigest:result.discovery.digest,receipts:result.evaluations.items.map(x=>x.receipt.id),memory:process.memoryUsage()});after=result.evaluations.nextAfter;}while(after);assert.equal(new Set(ids).size,ids.length);assert.equal((await t.timeline()).head,before);const durationMs=performance.now()-start,peakRss=Math.max(initialMemory.rss,...pages.map(x=>x.memory.rss));assert.ok(durationMs<=5000);assert.ok(peakRss<=536870912);assert.ok(peakRss-initialMemory.rss<=268435456);const report={date:'2026-10-28',scope:'Read-only complete actual-project fixed-pair dependency population, streamed page1 without retaining full page bodies; summary/IDs retained. No source observation or mutation.',nativeRevision:before,pair,boundary,pageSize:1,pageCount:pages.length,receiptCount:ids.length,duplicateReceiptCount:ids.length-new Set(ids).size,evidenceWatermark:digest,totalTransferredJsonBytes:totalBytes,durationMs,initialMemory,maxSampledRssBytes:peakRss,maxSampledRssGrowthBytes:peakRss-initialMemory.rss,pages,limits:'One local full-population run with full regression/browser check active. Page25 cap is a rejection, not a successful supported response. Read-only snapshot belongs to each callback; unchanged evidence watermark checked across the entire traversal. An initial driver incorrectly treated the explicitly page-scoped discovery digest as a population digest; corrected before retaining this report.'};writeFileSync('projects/tracer/concurrent-local-real-streamed-scope.json',await prettier.format(JSON.stringify(report),{...await prettier.resolveConfig('projects/tracer/concurrent-local-real-streamed-scope.json'),parser:'json'}),{flag:'wx'});console.log(JSON.stringify({pageCount:pages.length,receiptCount:ids.length,totalBytes,durationMs,peakRss}));}finally{r.close()}

limits: These are evidence/probe procedures, not a new supported orchestration framework. Live register mutation drivers are intentionally excluded. Timing measurements are local engineering evidence with explicit uncertainty; source reconstruction does not authorize changing live engineering judgments.
